headline: Knowledge Realty posts Q2 FY27: payout ₹1.72 per unit, up 11%
summary: NOI grew 15% year on year and committed occupancy reached 93% by area and 94% by value. In-place rents rose 7% to ₹101 per sq ft.

headline: Nexus Select declares ₹2.367 per unit for Q2 FY27, up 8%
summary: Retail NOI rose 8% to ₹504 crore and tenant sales grew 13%. It is the 13th straight quarter of a 100% payout; LTV stays at 18%.

headline: Mindspace NOI up 32% in Q2 FY27; payout steady at ₹6.67
summary: Growth came from leasing, rent increases and the Chennai acquisitions. Like-for-like committed occupancy hit a record 96.1%.

headline: Brookfield India REIT declares ₹5.70 per unit for Q2 FY27
summary: NAV rose to ₹392.38 per unit. The dividend share of the payout has climbed to 30%, from 16% a year earlier.

headline: Bagmane leases 1.2 msf in its second listed quarter; occupancy at 99%
summary: Payout of ₹1.55 per unit, up from ₹1.50 in Q1. LTV of 4% is the lowest among listed office REITs.

headline: SEBI issues framework for depository receipts on REIT units
summary: Foreign investors can hold foreign currency depository receipts backed by Indian REIT units, widening the overseas investor base.

headline: Embassy declares record ₹7.07 per unit for Q2 FY27
summary: Revenue rose 16% and NOI 15%. The REIT leased 1.5 msf and NAV rose 18% to ₹524.74. FY27 payout guidance of ₹27.00 to ₹28.60 stays in place.

headline: SEBI exploring letting REITs and InvITs invest in third-party projects
summary: A SEBI executive director said the regulator is studying the idea and wants more insurance and pension money in the sector. This is a proposal, not a rule yet.

headline: Nexus Select lines up eight retail acquisitions
summary: The pipeline supports its plan to double the portfolio by 2030, alongside the Guwahati mall and hotel deal already signed.

headline: RBI raises repo rate by 25 bps to 5.50%
summary: The MPC moved to a calibrated tightening stance. Higher rates raise borrowing costs on REITs' floating-rate debt; the next review is 2 to 4 December.

headline: Embassy board approves retail space buy at FIFC, BKC
summary: An 8,048 sq ft retail unit for about ₹48 crore, funded in cash, with completion targeted in Q3 FY27.

headline: Embassy raises ₹1,000 crore in first trust-level bank financing
summary: Three-year floating-rate NCDs at a 6.97% starting coupon, taken up by a European bank under RBI's June 2026 framework allowing banks to lend to REITs.

headline: SEBI board approves REIT and InvIT rule changes
summary: Certain unitholder votes will now need 75% of votes cast instead of 75% of all units, and depository receipts on REIT units were cleared.

headline: Nexus Select enters the Northeast with ₹1,600 crore Guwahati deal
summary: It is buying an under-construction 0.5 msf mall and a 164-key hotel, expected to close within 18 months. Management says LTV stays under 20% after the deal.

headline: Blackstone's 25% stake sale in Knowledge Realty fully subscribed
summary: The offer for sale raised about ₹12,100 crore and cut Blackstone's holding to about 21.5%, making Sattva the largest holder. The REIT received no new money.

headline: Six listed REITs paid ₹3,136 crore in Q1 FY27
summary: Payouts more than doubled from a year earlier, helped by two new listings. Sector gross assets crossed ₹3.17 lakh crore.

headline: Embassy to join Nifty 500 and become the only REIT in Nifty Midcap 150
summary: The inclusion took effect on 30 September 2026 and brings index fund and ETF buying.

headline: Parliament passes bill keeping REIT dividends tax free
summary: The dividend exemption for unitholders no longer depends on the SPV's corporate tax regime. Interest and other components remain taxable.
